releases.body:
- PacificEngine's Common Resources is no longer a dependency
- You can teleport to the Mapping & Backer Satellites now.
- Added keybinds to change the state of the Quantum Moon
- You can now give yourself the vision torch, every Solanum conversation stone, and every projection stone.
- Lantern/Artifact focus petals no longer go inside of the flames.
